meta.title: Delta Desktop
meta.description: Delta Desktop native DeepSeek Harness plugin with extensible appearance and settings.

ui.preference: Switch appearance without disabling the official layout, sessions or other plugins.
ui.unavailable: A required capability is unavailable or an action failed. Disable this plugin to restore the official UI.
ui.recovery: If Settings cannot open, disable dsh-delta-desktop in the Host Profile and restart.
ui.shortcut: The official layout owns shortcuts; this plugin does not override existing keys.
ui.personalizationDescription: Appearance and native-service search are available; remaining layout features depend on Host compatibility.
ui.appearanceDescription: Switch between Delta and native colors without changing sessions, models or plugins.
ui.hostOwned: Delta provides an additional search field using native Harness session services. Official search remains as fallback. Navigation and workspace ownership stay with the Host.
ui.searchDialogPrompt: Type to search sessions and workspaces.
ui.contextFeaturesDescription: Delta enables Harness's native compaction backend at the Profile layer so main-task and independent sidebar sessions can create structured checkpoints automatically. Harness keeps the session log and recent conversation; inspect checkpoints below.
ui.showDeepSeekAccountInfoDescription: Show or hide the DeepSeek Account route label in the composer. Sign-in, credentials, model selection, and requests are unchanged.
ui.showModelInfoDescription: Controls composer model labels; model selection and actual requests are unchanged.
ui.deepSeekModelsEnabledDescription: When off, DeepSeek and DeepSeek Account disappear from the model list and new requests to these routes are blocked. Running requests are not interrupted.
ui.inputOptimizationDescription: The result opens in a separate session for review and editing; it is written into the composer only after confirmation.
ui.redactionDescription: Mask recognized private-key blocks, labeled credentials, bearer/API tokens, valid payment-card numbers, date/checksum-valid Chinese resident-ID formats, email addresses, and phone numbers before model requests. Tool arguments stay masked. On by default.
ui.visionEnabledDescription: Describe images for text-only models. If the bridge fails, the conversation remains intact and the request stops.
ui.visionCredentialPlaceholder: API key (leave empty if not required)
ui.visionCredentialHint: The key is stored through Harness Credentials, not in plugin config. Supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages, and Ollama endpoints.
ui.visionMissingForm: The Harness Settings service is unavailable or read-only.
ui.visionAdmissionHint: For images sent to a text model, Delta first gets a text description from this vision model and passes that description to the selected text model. On failure, the image is never sent directly to the text model.
ui.visionFailed: Save failed or settings are invalid. Check the URL, model ID, credential name, and config permissions.
ui.visionKeySaved: Settings and key saved to Harness Credentials.
ui.optimizationDisabled: Input optimization is disabled in Settings.
ui.assistantUnavailable: Harness sidebar or session services are unavailable.
ui.assistantContext: This panel uses a separate session. Discussion will not stop the main task.
ui.noCheckpoint: No checkpoint is present in the loaded conversation.
ui.compactUnavailable: This session has no manual /compact command. Automatic compaction still runs before later model requests according to context pressure.
ui.automaticCompactionFailed: Automatic context compaction failed. The original session log is preserved. Check the Host log and try again after fixing the model or network issue.
ui.correctionPlaceholder: Write a correction or addition for the main task…
ui.reviewCorrection: Review the content to queue for the main task
ui.queueOnly: This is added to the main task queue and will not interrupt its current step. Review it before confirming.
ui.correctionQueued: Correction queued for the main task.
ui.directionChange: This correction changes task direction. Confirm its scope before sending.
ui.draftChanged: The main draft changed. To avoid overwriting new content, copy or merge the result manually.
ui.compacting: Harness is generating a structured checkpoint…
ui.compactFailed: The structured summary was not generated, so this attempt did not replace the conversation history. Check the Agent preset and model configuration, then retry.
ui.searchReady: Search and shortcuts: mounted in the native sidebar.
ui.searchWaitingServices: Search and shortcuts: waiting for Harness session and navigation services.
ui.searchWaitingSidebar: Search and shortcuts: waiting for the Harness sidebar.
ui.searchDisabled: Search and shortcuts: disabled in official appearance.
ui.archivedSession: This session is archived. Restore it in the native workspace list before opening.
ui.sessionStateUnknown: Session archive status is unavailable. Open it through the native session list.
ui.integrationSummary: The verified Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 does not expose four required extension contracts. Delta enables only supported additive features; the full desktop layout has not been activated.
ui.integrationSidebar: Full sidebar navigation composition: no public composition seat
ui.integrationCollapse: Default-collapsed Workspaces: no public view-state initializer
ui.integrationDeletion: Default Workspace deletion guard: no business-layer guard hook
ui.integrationRunning: Native chat running copy: no dedicated localization override
ui.protectedDefaultWorkspace: The default workspace is protected and cannot be deleted.
ui.signOutFromMenu: Please sign out from the account menu
ui.mcpAddDescription: Configure and manage MCP services for Harness agents
ui.mcpSubtitle: Manage MCP servers loaded by Harness. Saved configuration takes effect immediately.
ui.mcpSecurityNotice: Custom MCP servers can run code or access external services. Add trusted servers only; reference secrets as ${credential:NAME} instead of entering them directly.
ui.mcpUnavailable: This Host does not provide an MCP Manager, so live status, testing, and restart are unavailable. The settings form is still available.
ui.mcpNotConfigured: The MCP Manager settings form is not configured.
ui.mcpReadOnly: This connection is read-only. Save configuration from the local Harness Desktop interface.
ui.mcpNameHint: Use 1–32 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.
ui.mcpEnvHint: Use ${credential:NAME} for secrets managed by a Harness credentials provider.
ui.mcpHeadersHint: Use ${credential:NAME} for credentials; avoid long-lived literal secrets.
ui.mcpNoServers: No MCP servers yet. Add one to make it available to Harness agents.
ui.mcpDuplicateName: This name is already configured or registered.
ui.mcpInvalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
ui.mcpInvalidPairs: Enter environment variables and headers as one KEY=value pair per line.
ui.mcpSaveFailed: Save failed and configuration was not changed. Check the name, fields, and current revision, then retry.
ui.mcpRemoveFailed: Unable to remove the configuration. Refresh and try again.
ui.mcpRemoveSuccess: Configuration removed; inherited servers return to their base configuration.
ui.mcpOperationFailed: The operation failed. Check Host status and retry.
ui.mcpStdioNotice: stdio starts the configured command on the Host. Verify that the command source is trusted.
ui.mcpCredentialsNotice: Store secrets in Harness Credentials and reference them as ${credential:NAME}.
ui.mcpFormUnavailable: This Profile does not expose the MCP settings form. Check that the official Harness MCP Manager and Settings are loaded.
